ns2:course.label: Graduate College Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: (G C 399) Provides campus credit for study at accredited foreign institutions or approved overseas programs. Final determination of credit granted is made after the student's successful completion of work. Credit will not count toward residence requirements. Summer session I, 0 to 4 undergraduate or graduate hours; summer session II, 0 to 8 undergraduate or graduate hours. Prerequisite: Full academic standing in the Graduate College and consent of major department, Graduate College, and Study Abroad office.
